text: {"voice": 3, "model_prose": 3, "fidelity": 4, "note": "Faithful and plainly worded, with one semicolon nodding at the period style, but it is too short and clipped for this voice's long, varied, quotation-laced sentences, and it lands on the familiar model-prose close of the knife raised and the ram not yet seen; 'is kept before us' also softens 'holds together' slightly."}
